test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: The passage supports which of the following statements?

options.text: Flexible instructional practices prioritise the learning objectives of the curriculum.
The pattern of education has become teacher-centric today.
Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics enhance assessment platforms.
The role of teachers in personalised learning remains the same as in traditional learning.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Despite the introduction of personalised learning, the passage suggests that the **role of teachers does not diminish** or fundamentally change in nature, maintaining its significance as in traditional settings. (Paragraph 3)
 
• "AI can never replace educators; it can only enhance and support personalised learning" (Paragraph 3)

**Therefore, the correct answer is "The role of teachers in personalised learning remains the same as in traditional learning".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (1),** while might be hinted at, is not the main focus of the passage or directly supported, especially not in comparison to the explicit discussion about teachers' roles.
 
• **Option (2) **is directly contradicted by the passage which discusses the shift towards student-centric learning rather than becoming more teacher-centric.
 
• **Option (3)**, although mentioned regarding technology's role in personalized learning, the passage focuses more on the consistency of the teacher's essential role, making it less suitable as the best supported statement.
